name: exorcist killing lie
source:
Welcome to the whispered world of ghosts, exorcists, and petty gods!

One night, Nigel looks up from the balcony and sees his new cram school classmate, Iago, leaping across the rooftops. By coincidence, they become quick friends. But what might Iago be hiding?
